name: The Kickin' Crab
tagline: Cajun seafood boils with signature Kickin' sauce in the historic 1899 corner building
description: Located in the historic 1899 landmark building on East Chapman directly off Plaza Square (the iconic location that housed Watson's for over a century), The Kickin' Crab serves mouthwatering Louisiana-style seafood boils tossed in garlic butter, lemon pepper, and signature Kickin' Style sauce. Enjoy fresh crab, shrimp, clams, and draft beers surrounded by historic exposed brickwork.
historicNote: Occupies the celebrated 1899 commercial brick structure on East Chapman, retaining historic architectural details, masonry, and high beam ceilings from Orange's founding era.

specials.title: Kickoff Shellfish Combo
specials.description: Complimentary side of Cajun corn and red potatoes with every 2 lbs of peel-and-eat shrimp or crawfish.

specials.title: Tasting Tuesday: $6 Draft Pints

specials.title: Midweek Garlic Wings & Boil
specials.description: Half-price Cajun chicken tenders and basket fries when ordering 3 lbs or more of seafood.

specials.title: Thirsty Thursday Buckets

specials.title: Friday Lunch Kickin' Special

specials.title: Weekend Catch Feast
